records.name: king-jewel
records.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: one transparent 2D game-piece sprite and material reference for a real 3D Shogi collection called Carved.
Primary request: Photograph exactly ONE exquisitely crafted Japanese shogi king tile, made of fine honey-gold boxwood with subtle close straight grain. The single character is exactly "玉", in bold, balanced Japanese serif/brush-inspired strokes, deeply and precisely carved into the face and painted matte near-black inside the recess. The character must be faithful and immediately readable. This is a contemporary original design, not a replica of a named artist's piece.
Shape: a true symmetric pentagonal shogi wedge with one centered point at the top, short sloping shoulders, subtly tapered long sides, a straight bottom, and tiny polished 0.4mm chamfers. Maximum width 33mm, length 39mm; thickness approximately 9mm at the bottom tapering to 7mm at the pointed end. No decorative border. No other symbols, no maker's seal.
Composition: straight-down orthographic top view, point exactly upward, no camera tilt and no rotation. Centered on a square canvas, whole piece visible, tile occupies about 80 percent of canvas height. A very small natural lower edge is acceptable but don't use an isometric angle. Genuine transparent alpha background, no board, no pedestal, no cast floor shadow, no checkerboard.
Materials: photoreal dense boxwood, warm but not orange, quiet continuous grain running from bottom toward point, slight grain variation across the face, finely polished satin sheen. Engraving has sharply cut tiny inner wood bevels and dark inlaid pigment clearly below the face, not a raised printed decal. Black character has strong contrast; grain never interferes with legibility.
Lighting: restrained soft upper-left studio key with gentle fill; neutral balanced exposure, softly rounded edge highlights, crisp microdetail, no bloom or dramatic shadow. Product-quality realism and clean silhouette at a small game size.
Output: one isolated finished piece, high resolution, square. No extra text, no labels, no watermark, no frame, no extra object.
